title: Reconcile open tick pbb with rj0's close-path snapshot before dispatching pbb
body: rj0 required the worktree snapshotted before its pane close 'per tick pbb', but pbb is open and nothing existed to call, so rj0 implements the minimal snapshot itself: refs/ticfac/wip/<job-id> with parent HEAD, .tick//.ticfac//artifact-prefix exclusions, staged through a private index, recorded in wip-snapshot.json beside the attempt. pbb's remaining scope (if it still dispatches as written) must be re-planned against this: union the two, and let pbb own the generalisation — pointing a later attempt at its predecessor's snapshot (with nvn), and any snapshot policy outside the wall-clock close — rather than re-implementing the close's own gate.
